method.description: Direct comparison of all 54 final M2 CI screenshots against the authenticated final M1 attempt-2 screenshots. Original PNGs and reports were freshly downloaded from the six identified GitHub artifact archives.
authentication: GitHub workflow runs queried by exact source commit; final pipeline and branding conclusions read as success.
GitHub artifact metadata checked for run identity, exact source commit, archive byte count, SHA256 and expiry.
Archive paths checked for duplicates, symlinks and traversal before bounded evidence extraction.
Successful build and QA reports bind pack, release, output, composition and exact workflow execution; all retained PNG hashes were verified.
M1 build, QA and screenshot hashes match the committed final M1 visual corpus; immutable native template source releases match between both sides.

approvedException.name: fleet-design-mark-v1
approvedException.description: Previously approved M2 FAB artwork correction: replace the dealer mark inside the existing FAB with the active fleet design artwork. This continuation makes no visual or template changes.
approvedException.authorizationScope: Retained approved correction from the M2 branch state; no new exception introduced.
approvedException.bounds: Exactly the recorded 46 by 34 CSS-pixel artwork bounds, with only the comparator-validated 0 or 15 pixel scrollbar gutter adjustment.
approvedException.validation: Baseline dealer artwork and candidate fleet artwork hashes, single loaded visible image and matching retained geometry are required. Button border, badge, shadow and all other page pixels are compared strictly; caller-defined masks are forbidden.

scope.scopeNote: This authenticates the existing successful source599 build outputs and local CI screenshot evidence. Hosted route, HEAD, identity, CPU and startup qualification requires separate deployment and hosted receipts.
scope.sourceBinding: Applies to the exact candidate source commit and output digests above. Later metadata, workflow or documentation changes do not extend this result to different pack-producing code or different outputs.
scope.retainedArtifacts: Only JSON evidence is committed. Original build reports, QA reports and PNGs remain in the identified GitHub artifacts; local generated diff PNG hashes are recorded for reproducibility.
